terms.gloss: live like a Chian: in comfort and plenty
evidence: Petr. 63.3: ā puerō vītam Chiam gessī (Lewis & Short), s.v. Chios
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: “the Chians were noted for generous living”. Said by a freedman in Petronius; Lewis & Short marks the i of Chios as common, so it is left unmarked here.

sources: Lewis & Short: Chios · Lewis & Short: gero
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 102, checked against the searchable text and the page image (12 November 2026).
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
